_about: One page per region the app serves (BusBus/Transit/SupportedRegions.swift), built by i18n/regions.py at bus-times/<slug>/ (English) and bus-times/<slug>/<lang>/. order = the landing page's 'Where it runs' list, top to bottom. fit: full = live positions and times, arrivals = times only. web = the web app covers it (web/js/transit/regions.js). English texts under text.en; other languages' texts live in regions/<lang>.json under "regions".

en.name: Israel
en.title: Live Bus Times in Israel – Every Line, Every Operator | My Bus Stop
